corrected_secondary_source.captured_excerpt_text: XRP Insights reports $2.67B RLUSD across XRPL and Ethereum as of 2026-11-07: $884.3M on XRPL (33%) and $1.79B on Ethereum (67%). It reads XRPL issuer gateway_balances and Ethereum token totalSupply(), and excludes small supplies on Base, Optimism, Ink, Unichain and XRPL EVM sidechain. It reports the on-chain split cross-checks rl-tracker.com to under $1M.
corrected_secondary_source.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the normalized excerpt stored above; not the dashboard HTML, raw API response or XRPL/Ethereum ledger bytes.
limitations: This is a secondary dashboard reading XRPL issuer gateway_balances and Ethereum token totalSupply; raw ledger/block receipts were not archived in the referenced artifact.
The $2.67B total covers XRPL and Ethereum only; five smaller supported networks are excluded.
The reported under-$1M cross-check with rl-tracker.com is itself a secondary comparison, not independent primary evidence.
Do not compare the Nov 7 XRPL+Ethereum subtotal directly with Ripple's Nov 5 all-chain transparency total of $2.6329B; dates and network scopes differ.

reconciliation.difference_interpretation: Not a valid supply-growth calculation. The observations have different dates and network scopes, and the secondary split excludes smaller chains.

competing_hypotheses: The difference may reflect date changes, supply on excluded chains, dashboard methodology or data timing; it is not evidence of a $37.1M issuance event.
Any reported chain-specific supply change could reflect mint/burn, issuer treasury rebalancing, migration or wallet consolidation; transaction-level ledger receipts are required.
